The antipodal eigenlattice index is four via an integral determinant and primitive minors; bundled standalone checker passed.

value.rationale: A three-primary obstruction to splitting a natural integral homology module, despite H1≈Z^6 and rational semisimplicity, is a structural equivariant distinction not supplied by the familiar graph braid Betti numbers. The cube is a canonical, highly symmetric, 3-connected planar benchmark; the coefficient-ring threshold Z[1/3] and the complementary H2 signed face lattice make a meaningful and reproducible natural test case rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
